structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a lively media agency building in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant megaphone on its roof pointing up at the sky.
character: young PR intern (a South Asian woman in her early 20s, long dark hair, cream blazer, phone in hand)
scenes: she arrives with a coffee and flicks through a stack of newspapers and a tablet showing abstract headline blocks.
she types at a laptop with a long document of abstract lines, a small envelope icon flying out.
she talks on the phone at her desk beside a wall of contact cards and a corkboard of abstract cuttings.
she packs neat gift boxes with a product, a card and tissue paper ready for sending.
she sticks a printed article cutting into a big folder, smiling, a small tick floating above; dusk through the window.
props: a giant megaphone, speech bubbles, a camera, a microphone, newspapers, a paper plane, a star burst
